_what: Network classes for sim_relay.py. down = OME -> client (UDP), up = client -> OME (UDP), tcp = both directions of TCP (signalling, LL-HLS, RTMP ingest). Keys as in webrtc_impair/impair_relay.py. Re-read live.

residential._what: Cable/DSL: 0.3% loss + rare bursts, 15+-8 ms, 0.5% reorder, 200 ms stall every 40 s (webrtc_impair real_world_mix)

wifi._what: Busy 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi: 1% loss in bursts, 25+-15 ms, 1% reorder, 500 ms stall every 25 s

mobile_4g._what: 4G: 8 Mbps bottleneck with 300 ms queue, 60+-25 ms, 0.5% loss, 1 s stall every 30 s (handover)

terrible._what: Hotel Wi-Fi: 3 Mbps, 5% loss, heavy bursts, 120+-60 ms, 2 s stall every 20 s. Only must not hurt the server or other viewers.

lim._what: limits.py's viewer class: clean here, set live per test step with set_class

uplink_lim._what: limits.py's encoder uplink class: clean here, set live per test step with set_class

uplink_jitter._what: Encoder on a jittery residential uplink

uplink_stalls._what: Encoder whose uplink stalls 1.5 s every 45 s
